#import data
low=pd.read_csv("low_popularity_spotify_data.csv")
high=pd.read_csv("high_popularity_spotify_data.csv")
low=pd.DataFrame(low)
high=pd.DataFrame(high)

#generate music dataset
music=pd.concat([low, high])
music=music.dropna()

#drop some unwanted variables
music=music.drop(columns=['playlist_name','playlist_id','track_album_name','track_name','track_album_id','analysis_url','uri'])
In [160]:
#conduct feature importance
X2=music.drop(columns=['track_popularity'])
y = music['track_popularity']
cat_cols=[]
# Encode categorical columns
label_enc = LabelEncoder()
for col in X2.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns:
    cat_cols.append(col)
    X2[col] = label_enc.fit_transform(X2[col])

#Standardize the encoded columns
scaler= StandardScaler()
X2[cat_cols]=scaler.fit_transform(X2[cat_cols])

#Feature Selection
mi_scores = mutual_info_regression(X2, y, random_state=42)

feature_scores = pd.DataFrame({
    'Feature': X2.columns,
    'Score': mi_scores
}).sort_values(by='Score', ascending=False)

print(feature_scores)
